countdown.rule: input is held at zero until the countdown reaches GO; the timer starts at GO and the car is on the start line

rules.timer: elapsed engine ticks from GO at 1/60 s; it keeps running across a respawn and freezes on the finish
rules.gateOrder: checkpoints count only in index order; a finish crossing is rejected until every checkpoint is passed
rules.progress: progress is the arc length of the nearest point on the collision-raster course, clamped to the finish arc

respawn.target: the gate point of the last passed checkpoint (the start line before the first checkpoint)
respawn.rule: respawn when the chassis falls more than 1 m below the measured ground at its arc, stays airborne for 30 ticks, or leaves the declared band; the attempt timer keeps running

limits: the course is a project course traced on the collision raster, not the retail AI racing line
the declared 6 m band is the page controller/respawn band, not a road-width claim
the collision-raster clearance is the documented 1.68 m car band (1.5 m guaranteed clearance from blocked cells)
gate lines are rules geometry only; no gate mesh, start banner or race director exists for this map
